purpose: Describe the desired assessment movement precisely enough for Motion Lab generation and visual verification without conflating demonstration with compensation scoring.

startPosition: knees extended but not forcefully locked
arms overhead with upper arms near the ears
phaseSequence: controlled descent through the owner-reviewed MID geometry
hold the exact bottom pose for 0.18 seconds
controlled ascent through the same MID geometry in reverse
return to the exact overhead standing position
contactConstraints: generated bilateral leg IK owns planted-foot contact during loaded motion
Coach playback inserts grounded intermediate solve samples between named phases
no jump or heel-release phase is authored
trajectoryConstraints: pelvis descends and travels posteriorly using the existing owner-reviewed squat reference geometry
knees flex with hips and ankles rather than driving the motion alone
knees track in the same general direction as the feet
ascent mirrors the same geometry as BOTTOM -> MID -> START
arms remain overhead during descent, bottom, hold and ascent
finish returns to the same overhead standing pose
visualAcceptanceCheckpoints: bilateral foot grounding between as well as at named phases
return to exact overhead top position

assessmentObservation.importantBoundary: These are observation targets for a separate pose-analysis/scoring layer. The Motion Spec is the reference demonstration and does not diagnose causes or assign production severity thresholds.

calibrationPolicy.ownerAction: Use Motion Lab Pose Editor to visually correct the overhead setup if the coach avatar does not place straight arms near the ears, then promote that approved pose before treating arm geometry as canonical.

sourceNotes: Movement intent is adapted from the repository's existing Overhead Squat Assessment checklist.

Lower-body phase geometry intentionally reuses the current synthesized squat engineering reference so this test isolates whether adding a new movement contract and overhead constraint composes correctly.
